queries.query:
find view "view:pipeline:step_execution" s
| filter s.start_ts >= cast(${start_time} as timestamp) and s.start_ts <= cast(${end_time} as timestamp)
| filter s.step_type in ["HarnessApproval", "JiraApproval", "ServiceNowApproval", "CustomApproval"]
| filter ${project_filter_predicate}
| left join view "cd:step_execution_summary_harness_approval" a on a.step_execution_id = s.step_execution_id
| aggregate {
    case when a.approval_action = "APPROVE" then "Approved"
         when a.approval_action = "REJECT" then "Rejected"
         when s.status = "EXPIRED" then "Expired"
         when s.status = "ABORTED" then "Aborted"
         else s.status end as outcome,
    distinct_count(s.step_execution_id) as approvals
  }
| group_by outcome
| order_by approvals desc

find view "view:pipeline:step_execution" s
| filter s.start_ts >= cast(${start_time} as timestamp) and s.start_ts <= cast(${end_time} as timestamp)
| filter s.step_type in ["HarnessApproval", "JiraApproval", "ServiceNowApproval", "CustomApproval"]
| filter ${project_filter_predicate}
| join view "cd:step_execution_summary_harness_approval" a on a.step_execution_id = s.step_execution_id
| aggregate {
    a.approved_by_name as approver,
    case when a.approval_action = "APPROVE" then "Approved" else "Rejected" end as action,
    count() as approvals
  }
| group_by approver, action
| order_by approvals desc

widget.title: Weekly Approval Volume & Median Wait

queries.query:
find view "view:pipeline:step_execution" s
| filter s.start_ts >= cast(${start_time} as timestamp) and s.start_ts <= cast(${end_time} as timestamp)
| filter s.step_type in ["HarnessApproval", "JiraApproval", "ServiceNowApproval", "CustomApproval"]
| filter ${project_filter_predicate}
| aggregate {
    date_trunc("week", s.start_ts) as week,
    distinct_count(s.step_execution_id) as approvals,
    median(s.duration) / 1000.0 as median_wait_s
  }
| group_by week
| order_by week asc

widget.subtitle: Approval gates per week (bars) and median wait in seconds (right axis)

queries.query:
find view "cd:deployment_stage_execution" d
| filter d.start_ts >= cast(${start_time} as timestamp) and d.start_ts <= cast(${end_time} as timestamp)
| filter d.service_identifier is not null and d.service_identifier != ""
| filter ${project_filter_predicate} and ${service_filter_predicate}
| filter ${environment_filter_predicate} and ${env_type_filter_predicate}
| filter d.stage_status in ["FAILED", "ABORTED", "EXPIRED", "APPROVAL_REJECTED", "APPROVALREJECTED", "ERRORED"] or d.is_automated_rollback = true or d.rollback_duration > 0
| select {
    d.start_ts as started,
    d.service_name as service,
    d.env_name as environment,
    d.env_type as env_type,
    d.pipeline_name as pipeline,
    d.stage_status as status,
    case when d.is_automated_rollback = true or d.rollback_duration > 0 then "Yes" else "No" end as rolled_back,
    d.rollback_duration / 1000.0 as rollback_duration,
    d.failure_message as failure_message
  }
| order_by started desc
| limit 100

widget.subtitle: Audit list of changes that failed, were aborted or triggered a rollback

widget.title: Changes by Trigger Type & User

queries.query:
find view "cd:deployment_stage_execution" d
| filter d.start_ts >= cast(${start_time} as timestamp) and d.start_ts <= cast(${end_time} as timestamp)
| filter d.service_identifier is not null and d.service_identifier != ""
| filter ${project_filter_predicate} and ${service_filter_predicate}
| filter ${environment_filter_predicate} and ${env_type_filter_predicate}
| join view "cd:pipeline_execution_summary_cd" pe on pe.planexecutionid = d.plan_execution_id
| left join view "cd:view:pipeline_execution_summary" v on v.planexecutionid = d.plan_execution_id
| aggregate {
    case when v.triggered_by_name is null or v.triggered_by_name = "" or v.triggered_by_name = "NA"
         then "Unknown" else v.triggered_by_name end as triggered_by,
    pe.trigger_type as trigger_type,
    distinct_count(d.stage_execution_id) as changes
  }
| group_by triggered_by, trigger_type
| order_by changes desc
| limit 20

widget.subtitle: Who initiated deployments and how (manual, webhook, release orchestration)
